Anna thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. The weather was sunny that day. Anna hopes to visit Rome one day. Best of all, feeding the dog is his daily chore.
Last Friday, Anna and Mia went to the moon-lit yard. Anna bought a dress at the shop yesterday. Anna learned a lot about music. Also, the oak cradle rocks silently.
Anna usually has soup for breakfast. Mia is interested in dancing. Anna is going to travel to Rome in April. We feed the chickens every morning.
Life is full of small surprises. The moon-lit yard is one of the best places in the city. There are always many people at the dragon boat river.
